briefdescription.para: Runs unit-discovery, parse, and index jobs on a thread pool, and applies results to the index.

detaileddescription.para: Registers built-in languages and loads dynamic language libraries into index. UnitsJob discovers compilation units and emits the files tree. Each file row runs a ParseJob that updates syntax hashes and may emit a SymbolDocument.

Semantic indexing is demand-driven: requestUnit(), requestAllUnits(), or open buffers queue IndexJobs for requested or stale units. Running jobs preserve existing bindings until replacement jobs finish in handleAsyncUpdate(). Query requests wait for scope readiness via isRequestReady() while moveRequestJobsToFront() prioritizes blocking jobs.
